description: This file is a PHP source code defining the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include class, which implements the compilation logic for the {include} template tag in the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {include} tag in Smarty templates. It handles parsing the tag's attributes and generating the corresponding PHP code to include sub-templates, supporting features like caching, scope, and inline templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {include} tag into PHP code that renders the included template, handling attribute processing, caching logic, scope, and variable assignment.

methods.name: compileInlineTemplate
methods.description: Compiles an inline subtemplate into a PHP function, preparing it for rendering within the main template.
